name: lenamp
description: LENAMP — player local retrô. Sua música. Zero anúncios.

scripts.serve: npm run build && npx http-server www -c-1
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.cap:copy: npm run build && npx cap copy android
scripts.android: npm run build && npm run android:audio && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
scripts.android:add: npm run build && npx cap add android && npm run android:audio && npx cap sync android
